controls.label: Reservoir USDC Peg Stability Module

controls.label: Reservoir Credit Enforcer

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295029, PSM and Credit Enforcer DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE were confirmed as EOA 0xb7570e32 through hasRole() and RoleGranted/RoleRevoked logs. Both contracts are non-proxy AccessControl deployments. At Ethereum block 25575157 on 2026-07-20, the USDC PSM 0x4809010926aec940b550D34a46A52739f996D75D and Credit Enforcer 0x04716DB62C085D9e08050fcF6F7D775A03d07720 still returned that admin role, their EIP-1967 implementation slots were zero and the admin had empty code. The single unprotected EOA administers the PSM and Credit Enforcer issuance ceiling without an independent economic bound. Source-scope correction researched 2026-10-20: the prior inference that a real-time reserves view establishes continuous reconciliation is withdrawn. The current issuer API lists assets and aggregate rUSD, srUSD and wsrUSD liabilities, but supplies no upstream as-of clock or complete exact-deployment escrow/in-flight liability reconciliation. The product documentation describes a shared balance sheet rather than an independently established recurring whole-token accounting process. Reconciliation is unknown, not a measured finding that reconciliation does not exist. The previous supervision none annotation lacked positive scoped absence evidence; current issuer reserve, audit and legal surfaces do not establish a token-specific supervisory regime, so supervision is unknown. Original review start and control pins are retained.
